claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 1 show a blue rectangular console.
Witness only confirms a PlayStation logo and button icon pattern, no model number or slim-specific body shape visible under the plastic wrap.
No custom shell, sticker, or paint pattern described beyond standard PlayStation branding; console is still factory-wrapped in plastic.
No discs, game cases, or digital library screen are shown in any photo.
PES as a franchise ended in 2021 and was rebranded to eFootball; a 'PES 2027' title does not exist, making this claim factually impossible regardless of photos.

response.reason: The seller claims inclusion of a nonexistent game title (PES 2027), which is an impossible, fabricated claim rather than merely unverified, raising strong suspicion the listing is embellished or deceptive.
